objective.statement: Make Tabby a declarative Home Manager terminal client without creating a nonstandard terminal capability contract.
objective.measure: Eugeny/Tabby is installed from a hash-pinned upstream client release and its projected local-session environment explicitly preserves TERM=xterm-256color.

need.statement: Interactive TUI users have no declarative Tabby client or configuration, even though their existing terminfo contract is xterm-256color.
need.baseline: Tabby is absent from the host and dotfiles; TERM=tabby has no terminfo entry, while TERM=xterm-256color supports 256 colors.
need.consequence_of_no_action: Users must configure Tabby manually or risk advertising an unsupported terminal type to TUIs.
assumptions: Tabby local Linux sessions support a terminal.environment TERM override.
alternatives_considered: Create a custom tabby terminfo entry
Configure Tabby to use the existing xterm-256color contract

admission.reason: Operator requested Tabby terminal and terminfo setup under Nix/Home Manager.

purpose: Provide a declarative Tabby terminal client whose local sessions use the existing supported xterm-256color terminfo contract.
consumer: Interactive TUI users on cc-se-sto-devbox-01, including JCode and tmux sessions launched from Tabby.
contract: Home Manager installs the hash-pinned Eugeny/Tabby terminal client and projects configuration that explicitly keeps TERM=xterm-256color; the host has a working 256-color terminfo capability without a custom tabby entry.
failure_boundary: The change must not alter global shell TERM policy, remove WezTerm, or claim a custom tabby terminfo entry exists.

evidence.description: A dotfiles source contract fails before an Eugeny/Tabby module/config exists and passes only when it pins that client and declares TERM=xterm-256color.
After Home Manager activation, Tabby is on PATH and TERM=xterm-256color terminfo reports 256 colors.

falsifier.claim: Tabby local sessions use a terminfo contract that the host supports.

executable_check.command: env TERM=xterm-256color infocmp -x xterm-256color && test "$(env TERM=xterm-256color tput colors)" = 256
executable_check.description: A missing xterm-256color entry or non-256 color result falsifies the contract.

invariants: Tabby uses the established xterm-256color terminal identity
Home Manager is the owner of the Tabby package and config projection

assumptions.statement: Nixpkgs provides appimageTools and fetchurl to declaratively package the verified Eugeny/Tabby release.
assumptions.falsifier: The Home Manager activation package cannot evaluate the appimageTools-based terminal derivation.

assumptions.statement: Tabby config.yaml accepts terminal.environment.TERM for local session environment.
assumptions.falsifier: The documented Tabby local session source or configuration schema rejects the terminal.environment TERM mapping.

plane_constraints: A terminal emulator configuration is a client projection, not a NixOS system terminfo policy.
